description: Semantic search across the theme marketplace using bge-m3 embeddings (cosine similarity). Use when the brief is a natural-language description of industry + features (e.g. 'website mỹ phẩm có popup minigame và loyalty'), not just keywords. Returns top matches with theme_id, score, name, preview_url, thumbnail, description_vi/en

limit.description: Number of matches to return (default 5, max 10)

query.description: Natural-language description of the desired website (industry + features)

name: semantic_search_themes
